rationale: Both Kshitij and Sayla work at the intersection of semiconductor validation and hardware testing—Kshitij brings deep expertise in IP-level verification protocols (AXI, I3C) and verification frameworks from NVIDIA and Synopsys, while Sayla specializes in system-level electrical validation at Solidigm. Their complementary focuses on verification (design-level vs. system-level) and shared semiconductor domain create natural overlap for discussing validation methodologies and hardware validation challenges.
intro_message: Kshitij Gupta, meet Sayla Be — you both work in semiconductor validation and testing, and your IP/protocol verification expertise could offer useful perspective on her system-level validation work at Solidigm.
